commands.rule: Catalogue rows are discovery metadata, not proof of an executable. Only source-implemented commands successfully built for a target are binary-backed. Provider-backed and unavailable entries must remain distinct.

isa.rule: ISA instructions and encodings are instruction definitions, not one executable binary per instruction. A target-specific assembler/decoder/emulator backend plus conformance tests is required before claiming execution support.

architecture_builds.artifact_abi: Linux ELF cross-build artifact; not automatically a Koronos-native executable
architecture_builds.runtime_gate: Verify ELF ABI, loader/syscall compatibility, command behavior and BIOS/UEFI boot on the matching Koronos target before staging or release.

current_kernel_runtime: The current published native Koronos release is AMD64. Other architectures remain build candidates until kernel and userspace runtime acceptance passes.
